    while b - t + 1 > 3 and rt - l + 1 > 3:
        for c in range(l, rt + 1):
            out[t][c] = color
            out[b][c] = color
        for r in range(t, b + 1):
            out[r][l] = color
            out[r][rt] = color
        t += 1
        b -= 1
        l += 1
        rt -= 1

True def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not points:
        return out
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    right = max(c for r, c in points)
    t, b, l, rt = top + 1, bottom - 1, left + 1, right - 1
    colors = (2, 5, 0, 5)
    depth = 0
    initial_h, initial_w = b - t + 1, rt - l + 1
    while t <= b and l <= rt:
        h, w = b - t + 1, rt - l + 1
        if h == 1 and w == 1 and initial_h <= 7:
            break
        color = colors[depth % len(colors)]
        if h <= 2 or w <= 2:
            for r in range(t, b + 1):
                for c in range(l, rt + 1):
                    out[r][c] = color
            break
        for c in range(l, rt + 1):
            out[t][c] = color
            out[b][c] = color
        for r in range(t, b + 1):
            out[r][l] = color
            out[r][rt] = color
        t += 1; b -= 1; l += 1; rt -= 1; depth += 1
    # A single center cell is colored only in the larger recursive patterns.
    if t == b and l == rt and initial_h > 7 and initial_w > 7:
        out[t][l] = colors[depth % len(colors)]
    return out
